verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's marketing claims 'industry-leading analytics' tracking resolution quality, CSAT, revenue impact, and operational efficiency (lorikeet-docs-23), and Coach's Ticket Quality Score reviews 100% of conversations for quality (lorikeet-docs-9), suggesting some reporting capability exists. However there is no concrete evidence of an actual dashboard UI, no explicit mention of handoff rate or cost-per-resolution metrics, and no description of exec-reporting features or screenshots. missing for 10: dedicated dashboard UI evidence, explicit handoff rate metric, explicit cost-per-resolution metric, exec-reporting workflow detail
